name: Dandelion Tea
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO patients as it's FODMAP-free and may have mild digestive benefits. Some find it supports liver function.
preparationTips: Steep 1-2 teaspoons dried dandelion root or leaves in hot water for 5-10 minutes
Start with weaker concentrations if you're sensitive to bitter flavors
Can be consumed hot or cold throughout the day
Avoid adding high-FODMAP sweeteners like honey or agave
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants and vitamins A, C, and K
May support liver and kidney function
